$comment: Single source of truth for values referenced across .claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max, error-states, interface-states, and dashboard-reporting. Update here, not per-component — Tailwind config and any chart library theme should both derive from this file, not duplicate it.

color.$comment: Deliberately not orange/red-on-cream — see ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md for why. Verify all text/background pairs against WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text/UI) per accessibility/SKILL.md before shipping.

semantic.$comment: Used for error-states severity and interface-states success/warning — never the only signal, always paired with icon/label/shape per accessibility/SKILL.md.

chart.$comment: Ordered, colorblind-considered sequence for dashboard-reporting's radar/bar/line charts. Never rely on this sequence alone to distinguish series — pair with labels/patterns.

motion.$comment: See ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md — purposeful, not decorative. Respect prefers-reduced-motion per accessibility/SKILL.md for anything above 'fast'.

loadingThresholds.$comment: Referenced directly by interface-states/SKILL.md's loading-state rules — keep these two files in sync if either changes.
